name: Haus
short_desc: Meters, shared costs, tasks and wiki for a building shared by a few households.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Server for the Haus apps (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows): meter readings, the Betriebskosten split and yearly statement, tasks, appointments, equipment and a wiki. It has no web interface; open one of the apps and enter the app's domain.
